steps.en: The daily job creates and sends the 2nd letter to the vendor
steps.id: Job harian membuat dan mengirim surat ke-2 ke vendor
steps.why_en: The scheduled letter run is switched off; letters only go out when someone triggers it by hand.
steps.why_id: Job surat terjadwal dimatikan; surat hanya keluar kalau dipicu manual.

steps.en: Notices due for the 2nd letter are selected and given the latest address
steps.id: Notice yang waktunya surat ke-2 dipilih dan diberi alamat terbaru

steps.en: A letter data file with the fine is built for the vendor
steps.id: File data berisi detail surat dan fine dibuat untuk dicetak vendor

steps.en: The file is encrypted and sent, but sending is blocked by a setting
steps.id: File dienkripsi dan dikirim ke vendor, tetapi pengiriman diblok oleh pengaturan
steps.why_en: Sending to the vendor is deliberately blocked by configuration, so the file does not leave the system.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman ke vendor sengaja diblok lewat konfigurasi, jadi file tidak keluar dari sistem.

steps.en: After processing, the notice moves to the next stage and is marked as sent
steps.id: Setelah diproses, notice maju ke stage berikutnya dan ditandai sudah dikirim
steps.why_en: The notice is marked as sent and moves on even when the file never reached the vendor.
steps.why_id: Notice ditandai terkirim dan maju walau file tidak pernah sampai ke vendor.
